data.narrative:
Space Forge is a Series A-stage space and aerospace company that has raised $22.6M to date. The valuation assessment draws on a peer universe of 13 comparable companies—5 public (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private firms including SpaceX, Sierra Space, and Planet Labs—though narrow-filter peer matching proved constrained.

Of three valuation methods examined, only stage-progression proved applicable. Using total capital raised ($23M) as a valuation proxy and applying a typical 2.0x step-up multiplier from Series A to subsequent stages yields an implied valuation of $45M. Peer-median triangulation was not viable; while 11 same-sector comparables exist, the overlap of same-stage, adjacent-stage, and similar-tier companies fell below the three-datapoint threshold needed for statistical confidence. Public-comp anchoring using the Space & Aerospace median P/S multiple of 23.9x across six tickers could not be executed due to the absence of Space Forge's revenue figures, which private companies typically do not disclose.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $38M to $52M, with $45M as the central point estimate. Key uncertainties include the absence of revenue data, limited peer density at this stage and tier within the sector, and reliance on a single applicable method. Any refinement would require disclosure of Space Forge's current run rate or revenue guidance.
